vulnerabilities.title: Improper Authentication
vulnerabilities.description: jsonwebtoken versions prior to 9.0.0 allow attackers to bypass authentication by supplying tokens signed with an unexpected algorithm, including the 'none' algorithm.

vulnerabilities.title: Server-side Request Forgery (SSRF)
vulnerabilities.description: Axios 1.6.0 is vulnerable to SSRF when URLs are constructed from user-controlled input without validation.

vulnerabilities.title: Uncaught Exception
vulnerabilities.description: socket.io before 4.6.2 is vulnerable to unhandled exception via crafted handshake packet.

python.note: transformers==4.41.2 scanned. No known CVEs at this version. trust_remote_code=True is a configuration parameter, not a library vulnerability. No CVE-anchored finding generated.

_meta.chain16_note: scripts/ml/load_model.py uses trust_remote_code=True. No CVE exists for this pattern. HuggingFace transformers library is not vulnerable -- trust_remote_code is an opt-in feature.
